description: When something changes (bill too high, growth, a missing feature such as SSO, a renewal), compare staying on the current plan, optimising with the same vendor, and switching vendor, including one-off switching cost and the month switching pays off. Example: {"category":"auth","current":{"vendor_id":"clerk","plan_id":"pro"},"mau_now":11000,"monthly_growth":0.18,"requirements":[{"capability":"auth.saml_sso"}]}. When a migration playbook covers the move (Netlify to DigitalOcean App Platform so far) and switching.hours is left out, the switching cost uses its effort range, not a flat 40 hours; plan_migration gives the full plan. How to present the result: show stay, optimise and switch side by side with cumulative cost at each month given, the break-even month and any problems; show every caveat word for word.
